trap.label: agente com by
trap.wrong: The window was broken for the storm.
trap.right: The window was broken by the storm.
trap.why: Em português o agente da passiva é "pelo/pela" e o aluno pensa em for. Em inglês é by.

mcq.q: Qual é passiva no presente contínuo?

opts: The book was written from a nurse.
The book was written by a nurse.
The book was written of a nurse.

fix.wrong: The cake was eaten for my brother.
fix.right: The cake was eaten by my brother.
The street is being closed today.
